testsNotRun.tests/loader.spec.ts: loads the plugin through the real Loader (@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-loader), which generated apps do not install; the plain opener it wraps is tested here by open.spec.ts and conformance.spec.ts
testsNotRun.tests/crash.spec.ts: kills a child process that imports the package build (lib/), which a copy vendored into an app does not have; it runs in ACRYL
testsNotRun.tests/plain-entry-imports.spec.ts: a copy vendored into an app (with relative imports, no build of its own) has neither `lib/`; the app's own typecheck is what proves the copy names no Cordis type it does not provide.
